title: Unsent dispatch draft (location and text) is wiped by visiting Circle, Notebook or Map
where: Lightkeeper's desk, dispatch slip (Roster section), laptop 1440x900

steps: 1. Jonah (phone) rolls Move: Failure, Burn and reroll offered. 2. His connection drops (socket closed, reconnect held off ~3 s). 3. where: player desk, phone 390x844, dice button dot and After the roll
steps: 1. Jonah (phone) rolls Control (gilded, 2 dice): Keep one die, the dice button has its dot ('a choice is waiting'). 2. Before he keeps, Imogen rolls Survey at her desk. 3. Jonah keeps the regular 3: Failure. 4. Open the dice tray sheet; then send burn_resistance for Control.
